preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 500.
Each test case must have a number of stacks N between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(B) <= 50 for B in stacks)
preconditions.description: Each binary string B representing a stack must have a length between 1 and 50.
The starting player S must be either 'Dee' or 'Dum'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'0', '1'} for B in stacks for c in B)
preconditions.description: Each character in the binary strings B must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'Dee' or 'Dum' indicating the winner of the game.

postconditions.expression: any(stack[0] == '0' for stack in stacks) if S == 'Dee' else any(stack[0] == '1' for stack in stacks)
postconditions.description: If the starting player is 'Dee', there must be at least one stack with '0' at the top; if 'Dum', at least one stack with '1' at the top.
